Company description: JNJ (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) is a premier global healthcare holding company founded in New Brunswick, New Jersey, in 1886 by brothers Robert, James, and Edward Johnson. The enterprise operates through two primary sectors: Innovative Medicine and MedTech. The Innovative Medicine segment focuses on discovering, developing, and delivering advanced therapeutics to address complex diseases in areas such as immunology, oncology, neuroscience, cardiovascular, and metabolic disorders. The MedTech segment provides a broad portfolio of medical technology solutions, including advanced surgical instruments, orthopedics, vision care, and interventional solutions designed to improve patient outcomes worldwide. Having successfully completed the spin-off of its consumer health business into Kenvue in 2023, Johnson & Johnson is currently dedicated entirely to pharmaceutical innovation and medical technology.
